opts: 齐白石于1956年被授予国际和平奖。

listeningQuestions.audio: Van Gogh used very bright colours and dreamlike shapes.
opts: 梵高使用非常明亮的色彩和如梦的形状。

listeningQuestions.audio: Bob Dylan was the first songwriter to win the Nobel Prize for Literature.

quizQuestions.q: His paintings are full of feeling and fine ____.（细节)
He painted with bright colours and ____ strokes.（充满活力的)
Through his art he wanted to ____ a wish for peace.（传达)
He was deeply ____ for the great honour he received.（感激的)
The young painter hopes ____ his works in a real gallery one day.
Our teacher advised us ____ the opera at least once this year.
The bright colours made the whole room ____ warmer.
Painters use a variety of brushes ____ different effects.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
quizQuestions.audio: He was honoured as the People's Artist.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
quizQuestions.audio: She is hoping to become an artist one day.

reading.passage: Qi Baishi is one of the best-known Chinese painters of the twentieth century. He painted shrimps, flowers and doves in a fresh and lively manner, conveying his love of nature and his wish for peace. In 1956 he was awarded the International Peace Prize.
reading.passageCn: 齐白石是二十世纪最著名的中国画家之一。他以清新生动的方式画虾、花和鸽子,传达出对自然的热爱和对和平的向往。1956年他被授予国际和平奖。

questions.q: How did Qi Baishi paint his subjects?
opts: In a fresh and lively manner.
In a dark and cold style.

questions.q: What did Qi Baishi wish for through his art?

writing.prompt: Introduce an artist you admire for an art exhibition. Say who the person is, what he or she creates, the style, and his or her influence.
writing.promptCn: 为艺术展介绍一位你敬佩的艺术家:此人是谁、创作什么、风格如何、有何影响(试用「总—分」结构和不定式 to do)。

lines.text: I really want to visit the new art museum this Saturday.
lines.cn: 这周六我很想去新的艺术馆。

lines.text: Great! They are showing some famous ink paintings and Van Gogh's works.
lines.cn: 太好了!他们在展出一些著名水墨画和梵高的作品。

lines.text: Let's go in the morning, when it's quieter.
lines.cn: 我们上午去吧,那时人少些。

lines.text: Good idea. I'll check the website to see which artworks are on display.
lines.cn: 好主意。我去查网站看有哪些展品。

lines.text: Here's a clue: he painted shrimps and flowers in a lively manner.
lines.cn: 给你一条线索:他以生动的方式画虾和花。

lines.text: Is it Qi Baishi, the People's Artist?
lines.cn: 是「人民艺术家」齐白石吗?

lines.text: Yes! He was even awarded the International Peace Prize.
lines.cn: 对!他还获得过国际和平奖。

lines.text: Amazing. His works convey a real love of nature.
lines.cn: 了不起。他的作品传达出对自然真挚的热爱。
